name: Northampton Winter B 2023
information: **Please read all the above tabs before registering, especially Covid-19 Safety and Competitor Info.** * **The registration fee of $25.00 will be paid in cash on the day of the competition.** * **If you have registered and are no longer able to attend, please email the organizers to cancel your registration.** - Only one guest will be permitted per competitor. - Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age. - Proceeds from this competition will go toward Cube New England and the Smith College Trans and Non-Binary Alliance.
